text:
# Close wrap: Mon 2026-11-16

**Indexes:** Dow -1.41% to 51,608.17, S&P -1.92% to 7,416.59, Nasdaq -2.49% to 24,509.76, NDX -2.67%. SOX -5.28% to 9,610.65 with all 30 names down. Dow Transports +0.27%. VIX +23.8% to 23.89 ([TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262307685-us-stock-nasdaq-falls-nvidia-amd-drops-us-ai-chip-curbs-tradingkey), [Seoul Shinmun](https://www.seoul.co.kr/news/economy/securities/2026/11/17/20261117500006)).
**Why:** CNBC reported that NVDA's board isn't discussing bringing Huang back, and Commerce closed the loophole that let Chinese firms rent compute in third-country data centers. NVDA fell 4.1%, MU 7.6%, INTC 7%, LRCX 6.7%, ASML 5.9%, AMD 5.6%, AMAT 5.5%, TSM 6.3%, and ORCL 5%. The selling spread to banks on AI-financing exposure: GS and MS -3%, JPM -2% ([TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/u-s-market-closes-sharply-lower-as-ai-stock-plunge)). PG (+2%) and UNH (+1.1%) held up.
**Rates/Fed:** Warsh said AI could "disappoint." The 10-yr closed at 5.113% (-2bp) and the 2-yr at 4.817% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/16/treasury-yields-bonds-inflation.html), [Gate](https://www.gate.com/news/detail/us-10-year-treasury-yields-fall-223-basis-points-to-51129-on-november-16-25668005)).
**Covered:** TTWO opened at $230.04 and closed at $213.47 (-6.3%), so the conditional is void ([Exa](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stocks/TTWO), [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/take-two-stock-ttwo-drops-over-5-ahead-of-gta-vi-release)). COST ~$1,114 and LLY ~$1,433 in early AH ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/equities/after-hours)).
**After hours:** ACM +7% to ~$77.55 on Q4 adj EPS of $1.63 vs $1.59, a revenue miss ($3.9B vs $4.1B), a record $28.0B backlog (+13%), a 10% dividend hike, and an FY27 EPS guide of $6.15–6.35 vs $6.24 consensus ([BusinessWire](https://www.businesswire.com/newsAECOM-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-fiscal-2026-results [StreetInsider](https://www.streetinsider.com/Earnings/AECOM+%28ACM%29+Tops+Q4+EPS+by+4c%2C+Misses+on+Revenue%3B+Offers+FY27+EPS+Guidance/27354660.html), [MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/tools/screener/after-hours)).
**Tomorrow:** Retail sales 8:30, IP 9:15, HD/DIS BMO, NVDA AMC. The whole semi group is in avoid through NVDA.

**Swing ideas** (Nasdaq-slide day, so no unconditional new longs):
- **ACM** (CONDITIONAL): log at the 11/17 close only if the AH gain holds. The reason is a non-tech margin and backlog beat plus a dividend hike. Confidence: low. Risk: a >5% gap (skip-open rule), a revenue miss, and a guide only in line at the midpoint; the 8 AM call could flip it.
